outcome: Congenital anomalies (including central nervous system and musculoskeletal anomalies, anencephaly)
cohort: Fetuses delivered or aborted at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Coimbatore Medical College Hospital, India, between January 2022 and December 2023.
finding: The study identified a 2.6% incidence of congenital anomalies among delivered or aborted fetuses, with higher prevalence observed in those from rural patients and in stillborns, and central nervous system anomalies (e.g., anencephaly) being the most common type.
birth_weight: Variable collected and analyzed; no specific inclusion/exclusion range for the overall cohort was stated.
gest_age: Variable collected and analyzed; includes preterm deliveries and abortions, no specific inclusion/exclusion range for the overall cohort was stated.
